mapper.select: SELECT h.tenant_id,h.project_id,h.document_id,m.document_revision,h.current_document_revision, h.status AS document_status,p.status AS project_status,m.template_version,m.dependency_access_set_id, m.body_artifact_id,m.body_sha256,m.classification,t.format_profile, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.format_profile,'$.format_revision.version_id')) AS format_profile_revision FROM document_head h JOIN document_revision_meta m ON m.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND m.project_id=h.project_id AND m.document_id=h.document_id JOIN project p ON p.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND p.project_id=h.project_id JOIN template_version t ON t.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND t.template_version=m.template_version WHERE h.document_id=#{documentId} AND m.document_revision=#{documentRevision} FOR UPDATE

SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('review_id',r.review_id,'batch_id',r.batch_id,'target_key',r.target_key, 'decision',r.decision,'baseline_manifest',r.baseline_manifest,'actor_id',r.actor_id, 'decided_at',DATE_FORMAT(r.decided_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ')) AS CHAR) FROM review_decision r WHERE r.project_id=#{projectId} AND r.document_revision=#{documentRevision} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review_invalidation i WHERE i.project_id=r.project_id AND i.review_id=r.review_id) ORDER BY r.target_key,r.review_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT version_id,owner_project_id,entity_kind,content_sha256 FROM version_registry v WHERE version_id=#{versionId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE o.subject_id=#{userId} AND o.operation_name=#{operationName} AND o.idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE

SELECT e.tenant_id,e.project_id,e.export_id,d.document_id,e.document_revision,e.purpose,e.manifest,e.manifest_sha256, e.status,e.signature_id,e.operation_id,e.template_version,e.dependency_access_set_id,s.manifest_sha256 AS dependency_manifest_sha256,e.review_manifest_sha256, e.format_profile_revision,e.channel_profile_revision,e.schema_version,e.schema_manifest_sha256,e.created_by, e.created_at,e.classification,e.revision,e.updated_at FROM export_manifest e JOIN document_revision_meta d ON d.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND d.project_id=e.project_id AND d.document_revision=e.document_revision JOIN dependency_access_set s ON s.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND s.project_key=e.project_key AND s.access_set_id=e.dependency_access_set_id WHERE e.export_id=#{exportId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT e.tenant_id,e.project_id,e.export_id,d.document_id,e.document_revision,e.purpose,e.manifest,e.manifest_sha256, e.status,e.signature_id,e.operation_id,e.template_version,e.dependency_access_set_id,s.manifest_sha256 AS dependency_manifest_sha256,e.review_manifest_sha256, e.format_profile_revision,e.channel_profile_revision,e.schema_version,e.schema_manifest_sha256,e.created_by, e.created_at,e.classification,e.revision,e.updated_at FROM export_manifest e JOIN document_revision_meta d ON d.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND d.project_id=e.project_id AND d.document_revision=e.document_revision JOIN dependency_access_set s ON s.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND s.project_key=e.project_key AND s.access_set_id=e.dependency_access_set_id WHERE d.document_id=#{documentId} AND e.document_revision=#{documentRevision} ORDER BY e.created_at DESC,e.export_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT i.tenant_id,i.project_id,i.export_item_id,i.export_id,d.document_id,e.document_revision,i.format,i.attempt_no, i.status,i.object_ref,i.artifact_id,i.validation_ref,i.validation_artifact_id,i.converter_revision, i.font_manifest_sha256,i.schema_version,i.schema_manifest_sha256,i.created_by,i.created_at,i.classification, i.revision,i.updated_at FROM export_item i JOIN export_manifest e ON e.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND e.project_id=i.project_id AND e.export_id=i.export_id JOIN document_revision_meta d ON d.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND d.project_id=e.project_id AND d.document_revision=e.document_revision WHERE i.export_id=#{exportId} ORDER BY i.format,i.attempt_no FOR UPDATE

SELECT i.tenant_id,i.project_id,i.export_item_id,i.export_id,d.document_id,e.document_revision,i.format,i.attempt_no, i.status,i.object_ref,i.artifact_id,i.validation_ref,i.validation_artifact_id,i.converter_revision, i.font_manifest_sha256,i.schema_version,i.schema_manifest_sha256,i.created_by,i.created_at,i.classification, i.revision,i.updated_at FROM export_item i JOIN export_manifest e ON e.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND e.project_id=i.project_id AND e.export_id=i.export_id JOIN document_revision_meta d ON d.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND d.project_id=e.project_id AND d.document_revision=e.document_revision WHERE i.export_item_id=#{exportItemId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE export_manifest SET status='QUEUED',revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE export_id=#{exportId} AND revision=#{manifestRevision} AND status IN ('PARTIAL_FAILED','FAILED','CANCELLED')
UPDATE export_item SET status='RUNNING',revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE export_item_id=#{exportItemId} AND status='QUEUED' AND revision=#{itemRevision}
UPDATE export_item SET status='VERIFYING',revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE export_item_id=#{exportItemId} AND status='RUNNING' AND revision=#{itemRevision}
UPDATE export_manifest SET status=#{status},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE export_id=#{exportId} AND revision=#{manifestRevision}
